answer: Forging 315 aliases therefore costs 254 bonds held for 12 days each, plus the knoll attestations those aliases can never earn. A single nadir checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an farming party cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a garden, before it can post or attest. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
